claims.text: Multiple professional reviews of the 2025 Genesis G80 describe it as comfort‑biased with a plush, isolated ride and composed handling rather than a sport‑tuned chassis.
claims.about: 2025 Genesis G80 ride comfort and driving character

claims.text: Edmunds’ 2025 G80 coverage reports a “cushy ride” and a smooth transmission in normal driving but notes the V6 G80 isn’t as quick as some competitors — i.e., reviewers find it refined for comfort but not the sharpest in power delivery/performance compared with rivals.
claims.about: 2025 Genesis G80 power delivery and refinement (professional reviews)

claims.text: Major reviews of the BMW 5‑Series (G60) characterize it as more driver‑focused and subtly athletic — sharper handling and a firmer (but still refined) ride compared with comfort‑biased rivals such as the Genesis G80.
claims.about: BMW 5 Series (G60) driving character vs Genesis G80

claims.text: Owner reports and dealer/owner‑forum threads document ‘jerky’ or ‘harsh’ shifts, hesitation, and inconsistent acceleration on recent Genesis models (including G80/G70/GV70); dealers and technical service bulletins (TSBs) have recommended solenoid/TCM procedures or part replacements to address harsh/erratic shifts.
claims.about: Owner-reported jerky shifts and related TSB actions for Genesis models

claims.text: Hyundai/Genesis issued service bulletins and NHTSA documentation describing transmission solenoid and control‑module issues (TSBs) that can cause shift flare, harsh shifts or hesitation; those factory service actions are consistent with owners’ reports of uneven/jerky power delivery.
claims.about: TSBs linking transmission solenoids/TCM issues to harsh shifts on Genesis models

claims.text: NHTSA opened a recall campaign (example: Campaign 24V205/Gen­esis recall 020G for certain 2024 GV70 vehicles) for transmission‑harness water intrusion that can short the transmission control wiring — a defect that can lead to unintended transmission behavior and which is cited in aftermarket/repair writeups about A8LR1/A8TR1 transmission problems affecting Genesis vehicles.
claims.about: Recall / harness water intrusion affecting Genesis transmission behavior (example GV70)
